logp.method_description: To a mixture of 1-octanol/DPBS (pH 7.4, 1:1, 1 mL) was added a 5 μL aliquot of the purified ethanolic solution of [99mTc]TcN(L1–5). The complexes were agitated using a vortex mixer (1 min, 3000 rpm) and left to equilibrate at room temperature for 1 h then were centrifuged (10000g, 5 min). From the mixture was taken 50 μL each of the organic and aqueous phases, and samples were diluted to 1 mL with EtOH and counted over 20 s using a Multi-Wiper HE γ-radiation well-counter (2008 Laboratory Technologies, Inc.). This process was repeated until three concordant results were achieved. Distribution ratios (D) are reported as counts min–1 mL–1 of 1-octanol divided by counts min–1 mL–1 of DPBS (pH 7.4).
